messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: generation_latency.p99 exceeded SLO in pool contbatch-us-west-2; current p99=2.4s (threshold=1.5s). Paging oncall. thread:4043219999
ravi: taking this. switching oncall to me. quick status: any infra deploys in last 20m?
maria: nothing from prod-deploy. nodes reporting normal CPU/GPU. metrics: https://grafana.redwood/prod/contbatch?orgId=1&var-pool=us-west-2&from=-20m
kevin: confirming spike started ~18:01 UTC. p95 jumped from ~110ms to ~380ms, p99 around 2.2-2.8s. streaming sessions show intermittent stalls and elevated queue depth.
cs-liaison: customers A and C opened support tickets describing timeouts and retries; no 5xx observed at gateway but user-perceived latency high.
slo-bot: SLO notifier: generation_latency.p99 > 1.5s for >10m. Severity P2.
ravi: pulling batcher logs and packer metrics. grabbing packer tail now.
kevin: i see heavy padding_perc in packer. mixed seq lengths (few requests at ~1.6k tokens) plus many short ones <= 48. packer is packing to max_batch causing padding amplification and increased wait_ms for short requests.
maria: that would explain streaming stalls: KV cache churn when large batches from long seqs flush cache, and short streaming flows get delayed behind packer_shim.
jen: can we apply a short mitigation quickly? list options.
ravi: mitigation candidates: 1) quick reduce max_batch for contbatch-usw2 from 128 -> 56 and enable seq_len_bucket heuristic; 2) enable immediate-flush for short sequences (seq_est < 64) after X ms; 3) preemptive-shed for lowest priority routes to free packing slots. I'd prefer (1) for minimal surface area.
kevin: agree. (1) has minimal code change (tunable update) and should reduce padding. downside: slight throughput hit.
jen: any danger to dedicated or private pools?
maria: config change will be scoped to contbatch-usw2 only. no dedicated/private touched.
ops-bot: runbook step: apply pool tunables. Requires oncall approval to run.
ravi: approving and applying now: `./opsctl tunables set --pool contbatch-us-west-2 --max_batch 56 --seq_bucket=true`
ops-bot: tunable update executed by ravi at 2026-03-15T18:06:15Z. Applying across pool; ~15s propagation window.
kevin: monitoring.. graphs show improvement within 30s. p95 ~130ms, p99 trending down to ~900ms. padding_overhead metric dropped from ~68% -> ~34%.
cs-liaison: customers reporting recovery: enterprise A confirms retries success rates back to normal.
jen: good. check for regression in throughput or cost.
maria: throughput per GPU in pool decreased ~5% but effective latency and customer-facing errors improved. KV eviction logs dropped after change. sample logs post-change:
```
2026-03-15T18:07:02Z contbatch/pack.cpp:104 pack_size=48 padding_pct=32 avg_seq=420 wait_ms=22
2026-03-15T18:07:05Z stream/handler.cpp:447 stall_detected duration_ms=12 kv_evictions=0
2026-03-15T18:07:07Z contbatch/scheduler.cpp:238 batch_size=40 seq_len_max=128 shim_wait=8
```
ravi: good. marking current state: mitigation applied, metrics improving, customer impact reducing. setting severity -> monitoring.
jen: assign follow-ups and owners before handing back oncall.
kevin: i'll run mixed-seqlen perf sims across machine types to find optimal per-hw max_batch and bucketing thresholds. assigning to kevin + infra. ETA EOD. ticket: TKT-1219.
maria: i'll open runtime ticket to implement an early flush heuristic for short sequences: if shim_wait > 70ms and seq_est < 64 then flush. Ticket: RNT-440.
cs-liaison: i'll send brief customer update, list mitigation and ETA for follow-up. include workaround: prefer dedicated models or client-side chunking for long contexts.
ravi: operational items: 1) keep reduced max_batch for 4 hours as temporary mitigation; 2) add padding_overhead and avg_seq metrics per-customer and per-pool to dashboard; 3) schedule config rollout for seq_len_bucketing across contbatch globally after sims; 4) prepare postmortem. leaving detailed notes in handoff doc: https://confluence.redwood/ops/4043219999-contbatch-pack-shim-incident
jen: handoff plan: ravi will keep oncall for next 8 minutes then hand back. postmortem owners: ravi (root cause and runbook), kevin (perf sims and recommended defaults), maria (runtime changes), cs-liaison (customer comms).
ops-bot: incident update: mitigation applied -> monitoring. Incident moved to status: mitigated at 2026-03-15T18:20:00Z.
ravi: adding collected logs and trace ids to ticket. will attach packed profiles and KV eviction traces.
kevin: I'll include simulation configs and results in TKT-1219. will propose adaptive max_batch per-pool based on observed seq distribution.
maria: also proposing a canary guard when changing packer tunables: run change on 5% of pool first and watch padding_overhead and p99 for 10m before full rollout.
cs-liaison: customer comms sent to impacted tenants. no escalations.
jen: nice triage. we'll reconvene in postmortem to finalize long-term fixes. thanks all.
ops-bot: thread archived. end of thread.
